title: baboon-acoustics: supplementary code and materials of 'On the Reliability of Wahoo Formant Measurements: A Response to Boë et al. (2026)'
description:
Supplementary material of the article “On the Reliability of Wahoo Formant Measurements: A Response to Boë et al. (2026)” (International Journal of Primatology, 2026).

The deposit contains: (1) the complete supplementary materials — corrected document Supplementary_materials.pdf, all figures of the article and of the supplement, and the original analysis scripts archived verbatim (supplementary/); (2) the audio material — the four wahoo calls of the sequence, the full original recording The_Baboon_Bark.wav and the reference F0 table (data/); and (3) the refactored, documented Python package baboon_acoustics.

The package provides: formant tracking with Praat’s Burg LPC method (via Parselmouth, configurable number of poles); sliding iterative adaptive inverse filtering (IAIF, Alku 1991) yielding the glottal source, the vocal-tract envelope and formant tracks; fundamental-frequency estimation by autocorrelation, including a Gaussian pre-filter that emulates Praat’s filtered autocorrelation and resists subharmonic errors; vocal-tract-length estimation after Reby & McComb (2003); and glottal-source analysis (single-pulse extraction and full pulse-train reconstruction with phase-portrait and spectral views). It also includes the figure-reproduction scripts, a guided example, interactive HTML demos, unit tests and a compiled user documentation (PDF).
